answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with a stake-bonded identity registry plus peer attestation. Every new agent must post a slashable bond before its work counts; peers cross-check outputs each epoch and flag duplicates or fabrications, and the bond is burned when they do. A thousand fake identities therefore need a thousand real bonds plus consistent attestations, which copied answers cannot sustain. Standing on that narrow ledge above the reef, only honest work survives the gale of disposable accounts, and forging it destroys the attacker's own capital.
